Scope note 2026-10-15T05:01Z from the filing seat (`session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, os-bill) after the maintainer reviewed the prototype (chat, 2026-10-15). Three items; the dev reads them together with the card.

1. **Narrowing: the page header loses the favorite star.** Item D said "icon, title, the favorite star, the description inline". Drop the star: the one-row header is icon, title, description, actions. The maintainer's words, verbatim: 「合并为 Pinned 可以，但是这个功能常用吗？需要放在列表页右上角的明显位置吗？你的设计图我也没看到这个按钮」. The favorites rework is #12427 (blocked on this card); removing the button here means #12427 never has to touch this header again. Update the `object-favorite-btn-*` pins deliberately; the `useFavorites` wiring in `ObjectView.tsx` stays, since the record page and #12427 still read it.
2. **Clarification: the active tab's ▾ menu stays.** A2 removes only the per-tab filter/sort micro-icons. The per-view actions menu on the active tab (Rename, Duplicate view, Share view, Set as default, Pin view, Edit view config, Delete view), the right-click menu and the inline rename are unchanged. The default-view ★ drawn on the tab is retired together with the micro-icons; "Set as default" in the menu shows the current state instead (a check mark or a "current" label). The width derivation counts the chevron on the active tab.
3. **Verification widths are the seat's work, not the dev's.** The seat screenshots the PR head at 1440, 1024 and 390 px against the HotCRM demo. At 1024 the strip is expected to fold more tabs and the four controls to keep their labels; at 390 the existing phone shape applies (the mobile view switcher in the app bar, labels hidden). This card builds nothing new for those widths; what the screenshots show decides any follow-up.

Reading time 2026-10-15T05:01Z.
